interaction.web: The trigger opens the Dialog; typing in ModelSelectorInput filters the rows by their value string; ArrowUp and ArrowDown move the highlight, Enter or a click calls onSelect, and the caller sets the model and closes the dialog. There is no corner close: showCloseButton is false, so Escape and a press outside the dialog close it.
